title: ExprLibrary
description: Schema for an ExprLibrary compendium entry (Rpg/Scripting/ExprLibrary.cs).

Expr.description: An expression: either a DSL string (leading '=', e.g. "= 1 + target.constitution"; see Rpg/Scripting/DOCS.md) or a literal (number, string, boolean, null, or an array of those).

ExprLibrary.description: Library of named expressions that can be used in other expression fields.

additionalProperties.description: Any expression type (number, condition, string, effect, entity, body, body part, component, or an array of any of these) that can be used in other expression fields by referencing its name.
